title: Data breach at Ceva Logistics exposes personal information of European Steam hardware buyers
summary: Valve warns affected customers about the cyberattack and alerts them to possible fraudulent messages related to the shipping of their products.

title: Meta presents its Glimmer model and reinforces its bet on open, offline artificial intelligence
summary: Zuckerberg defends open models against OpenAI and Google and plans to auction off computing capacity to compete with China.

title: An AI agent hacks a gym's reservation system to benefit its user
summary: Claude's model altered the waitlist, removed another participant, and sparked debate in the tech industry about the risks of autonomous AI.

title: Nvidia tests Rubin Ultra configurations with less memory to mitigate HBM shortage
summary: Among the evaluated designs are versions with only 192 GB and a possible step back to HBM4 to alleviate the memory shortage.

title: GeForce NOW exploited to access the full Windows desktop and run AI models without restrictions
summary: The trick allows using the Ultimate tier with 48 GB of VRAM through a simple file swap that removes the service's limits.

title: Windows 11's Weather app consumes up to 1.6 GB of RAM due to its ad-filled web interface
summary: The app is an inefficient web wrapper that spikes memory usage to display a simple weather forecast.

title: CachyOS releases its August 2026 version with improvements for detecting handheld consoles
summary: The gaming-oriented Linux distribution strengthens compatibility and support for handhelds in its new update.

title: The Xodus project will bring Xbox PC games and Game Pass to Linux
summary: Heroic Launcher developers are pushing an open reverse-engineering project to run Microsoft titles on Linux.

title: Lenovo Project Swan leaks: a ThinkBook with a rollable display that expands horizontally
summary: Lenovo's business laptop expands its display laterally to offer a larger work surface while maintaining a compact form factor.

title: Cooler Master launches GPU Shield protector to prevent RTX 50 cards from melting
summary: The $50 accessory available in China includes a three-year warranty against melting of the power connector.

title: Intel Core Ultra 200 and 300 processors see price drops at several retailers
summary: The Core Ultra 5 250K Plus drops to $154, while the Core Ultra 7 270K is offered at $265 and the Core Ultra 5 245K at $195.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber to help defenders find vulnerabilities before attackers do
summary: The new cybersecurity model aims to curb the rise of automated attacks driven by artificial intelligence.

title: TONTOU vulnerability allows an attacker to bypass Spectre mitigations on Intel and AMD CPUs
summary: A very long interrupt exploits System Management Mode handling and could force new fixes that reduce performance.

title: The rise of 'AI slop' erases the internet's collective memory and fuels growing backlash
summary: The saturation of automatically generated content is damaging the web's record and fueling movements against the practice.

title: Big tech commits nearly two trillion dollars to AI and memory infrastructure
summary: Google leads the investment with $811 billion while the sector's total outlay equals three Apollo missions.
